body.query: resources | where type in~ ('microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults', 'microsoft.dataprotection/backupvaults') | project id, name, type = tolower(type), properties
resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' | summarize vms = count()
resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' | where tostring(tags['criticality']) =~ 'critical' | project id = tolower(id), name
